name: crafthub-extract
description: CraftHub local activity extractor — turns local git history and Claude Code sessions into hashed, aggregated activity metadata you review before anything is uploaded.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.build.json && rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.ts src/bin/crafthub-extract.ts src/bin/crafthub-hook.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --external:zod --outbase=src --outdir=dist && chmod +x dist/bin/crafthub-extract.js dist/bin/crafthub-hook.js

author: gabrikf
